title: QuantPlan
description: Complete candidate model request, not a frozen recipe or quality claim.

architecture.description: Exact architecture identifier; the NN loader owns execution admission.

assets.description: Complete sorted unique asset basenames, including config/tokenizer.

levels.description: Complete sorted unique quality/size level labels.

tensors.description: Complete sorted unique source inventory and operations.

AdditiveLayout.description: Semantic layout parameters for an additive tensor.

max_planes.description: Maximum plane count represented by this tensor.

tile.description: Canonical tile width. Currently fixed at [`ADDITIVE_TILE_SIZE`].

Basis.description: Input-axis transform associated with an additive tensor.

oneOf.description: No transform.
Normalized, self-inverse Walsh–Hadamard transform.
Deterministic signed Walsh–Hadamard transform.

domain.description: Stable domain identifier for sign derivation.

DirectFitLevel.description: One requested direct fit; plane counts need not be sorted or nested.

name.description: Unique nonempty level name within this request.

planes.description: Positive plane count bounded by the layout and its admitted law.

DirectFitLimits.description:
Pre-allocation shape limits for one direct-level request.

These bound specified logical element counts, not total process RSS, solver
temporary storage, Rayon overhead, or complete production memory admission.

max_metric_entries.description: Maximum dense input-Gram count (`cols * cols`), even when implicit identity is used.

max_output_trits.description: Maximum sum of retained trits over all directly fitted levels.

DirectFitMetric.description: Original metric supplied to the controller, before any basis transform.

oneOf.description: Explicit plan invocation without an input Gram.
Exact row-major f64 Gram bits; not original calibration data identity.

DirectFitPlan.description:
Typed per-tensor direct-level fit request, not the complete model QuantPlan.

The layout is the highest permitted plane count. Each returned level has
its own exact plane count as `max_planes`, and is fitted from the same
original source rather than from a prefix or another level's reconstruction.

layout.description: Declared geometry, law, basis, packing codec and transport.

limits.description: Required explicit shape limits, checked before numerical allocations.

DirectFitProfile.description: Exact numerical profile, not an interchangeable precision or SOTA claim.

oneOf.description: Tied one-third F16 ladder with the shipping activation-aware arithmetic.
Free F16/F32 planes fitted independently per group with the existing joint solver.
Joint f32-input group fitter with validated full-Gram sequential feedback.

FitInputDigest.description:
Exact original fitting input bits under a named candidate digest domain.
Not a stored blob, package, HF identity or calibration dataset identity.

JointFeedbackFitOptions.description: Joint row-group fitting with full input-axis sequential residual propagation.

damp.description: Full-Gram feedback damping relative to the mean diagonal; finite and nonnegative.

decay_ramp.description: Ramp from one to the configured fraction along the input axis.

fitter.description: Existing f32-input joint solver configuration; no f64 solver is implied.

precision.description: Working feedback arithmetic, independent of stored scale precision.

JointGroupFitOptions.description:
Existing joint fitter applied independently to each row-local scale group.

This profile does not propagate cross-group residual feedback, implement K-FAC
output curvature, or claim to be the full SALT campaign solver.

modulated_relay.description: Enable the existing modulated-relay initialization basin.

ridge_condition_limit.description: Finite ridge condition-number limit greater than one.

softened_relay.description: Enable the existing softened-relay initialization basin.

LadderFitOptions.description: Shipping f32 working weights with f64 metric/feedback/search arithmetic.

damp.description: Finite, nonnegative damping relative to the mean input-Gram diagonal.

decay.description: Finite feedback fraction in `0..=1`; one is plain GPTQ.

decay_ramp.description: Ramp feedback from one to the configured fraction along the input axis.

grid.description: Quarter-octave anchor grid candidates per group; zero retains the legacy single guess.

LadderScaleRefit.description: Placement of the ladder scale refit, without changing its numerical policy.

oneOf.description: Do not refit ladder scales.
Refit during the post-feedback coordinate search.
Refit completed groups before propagating to the remaining columns.

PlaneAllocation.description: Uniform or per-tile plane-count allocation policy.

oneOf.description: Every tile uses the tensor's maximum plane count.
Each tile records its own plane count.

PlaneCodec.description: Compact code used for each additive ternary plane.

oneOf.description: Two-bit ternary packing.
Base-3 packing of five ternary coefficients per byte.
Structured sparse 3-of-4 encoding.

PlaneRelation.description: Relationship between scales of successive additive planes.

oneOf.description: Every plane has an independently fitted scale.
Plane `p` has scale `s0 * (num / den)^p`.

den.description: Denominator of the positive scale ratio.

num.description: Numerator of the positive scale ratio.

QuantAction.description: Requested transform; preservation does not claim ternary weights.

oneOf.description: Preserve exact source bytes and original precision in every model level.
Independently fit all requested levels from this original source.

metric.description: Explicit identity or exact expected original f64 Gram content.

plan.description:
Existing per-tensor production fitting request, boxed to keep dense actions small.
Boxing is transparent to the derived wire representation.

QuantLimits.description: Logical byte bounds, not complete memory/RSS or solver admission.

max_asset_bytes.description: Sum of original assets retained in the output.

max_package_bytes.description: Complete output package bound, enforced before writer allocation.

max_retained_blob_bytes.description: Sum of unique encoded output blob payload bytes.

max_source_bytes.description: Sum of actual original tensor payload bytes.

QuantSourceTensor.description: Original tensor interpretation, never an adapter-supplied content hash.

precision.description: Original stored float precision, before widening or fitting.

shape.description: Positive row-major dimensions in the original source.

QuantTensorPlan.description: One exact source binding and its requested operation.

action.description: Preservation or the actual numerical profile/metric selection.

source.description: Original source interpretation must match discovery exactly.

ScaleAnchor.description: Grouping axis to which an additive scale is anchored.

oneOf.description: One scale per declared group.
One scale per matrix row.
One scale for the complete tensor.
One scale per output channel.

ScaleLaw.description: Scale law represented as orthogonal anchor, relation, and storage precision.

ScalePrecision.description: Precision used to store additive plane scales.

oneOf.description: IEEE binary16.
Brain floating-point 16-bit.
IEEE binary32.

Transport.description: Optional entropy transport applied outside the tensor's plane codec.

oneOf.description: Store codec bytes directly.
Joint Huffman coding with the specified block width.

block.description: Number of symbols grouped into one entropy-coding block.

WorkPrecision.description: Arithmetic of sequential feedback, not the storage precision or memory footprint.

oneOf.description: f32 working values/residuals, with f64 metric and correction accumulation.
Existing f64 feedback oracle; a selected fitter may still accept f32 inputs.
